methodology.safety_full_accuracy: Exact four-label accuracy over every R2 program; UNKNOWN remains a distinct ground-truth/prediction label.
methodology.safety_safe_unsafe_precision_recall: One-vs-rest on determinate ground truth only (SAFE, UNSAFE, CONDITIONALLY_SAFE). Ground-truth UNKNOWN rows are excluded from these class metrics and are counted/listed separately. CONDITIONALLY_SAFE is a negative for the SAFE and UNSAFE one-vs-rest metrics.
methodology.category_safety_accuracy: Determinate-ground-truth exact accuracy is the primary category safety accuracy; raw all-program accuracy is also included. UNKNOWN ground-truth cases are not converted to SAFE.
methodology.ea_roles: Boolean role metrics are calculated against the frozen per-program role labels for all locked programs. Macro metrics average only mathematically defined per-role values and report the included role count.
methodology.undefined_metrics: Undefined precision, recall, or F1 is represented as null in JSON and "Undefined" in Markdown/CSV.
methodology.analysis_failures: A failed analysis is not interpreted as UNKNOWN; it is reported separately. No analysis failures occurred.
methodology.comparison: v1/v2 benchmark scores are archival snapshots on their named datasets/splits. They are displayed side-by-side with R2 only with explicit dataset/provenance caveats; no incompatible sets are treated as paired.

rows.comparability_note: Tuned/development set; optimistic. Same 18-program set also used by v2 development.
Held-out benchmark with v1; distinct from the 18-program development set and current R2 corpus.
Saved v2 candidate snapshot on the same 18-program development set; candidate fingerprint does not match R2 run fingerprint.
Current frozen R2 corpus; different 936-program dataset and broad label composition, so do not treat score deltas as paired gains.

v1_development.caveat: Development-set results; detector was tuned on this 18-program set.

v1_historical_evaluation.caveat: 51-program held-out evaluation of frozen v1; crossover precision/F1 undefined due zero predicted positives.

v2_development_candidate.caveat: Saved v2 candidate development snapshot; same 18-program dev manifest as v1, but candidate component hashes differ from the R2 implementation fingerprint.

v2_current_r2.caveat: Current R2 role metrics on 936 reviewed programs; not a paired comparison with the benchmark sets.

corpus_comparison_excluded.reason: Ground-truth metrics are null; the corpus has no role-level labels and is not valid for precision/recall comparison.
